newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares in doldrums, negative trend sets in.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares in doldrums, negative trend sets in.

text.p: Danish share prices closed down in sour trade on Friday, hit by the lower Dow and dollar, with dealers seeing further falls ahead.

"The index was dragged down by earlier falls in bond prices, a lower Dow and a weaker dollar. The market was very quiet with investors keeping a low profile up to next week's start to the corporate interim result season. It looks the correction could well continue into next week," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index lost 0.68 point to close at 185.73 with the KFX August future 2.55 point down at 184.70 with 289 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
A disappointing interim result for Sweden's Astra rubbed off on Novo Nordisk, which finished 11 crowns lower at 714.
The day's most traded paper was Unidanmark with 254,000 shares changing hands to close 11 crowns up at 422.
Overall turnover for the day was 1.036 billion crowns.
